## 中文原文

傍晚在家做简单晚餐。走进厨房，从冰箱拿出蔬菜和鸡蛋。冲洗蔬菜，切好食材。开火，倒油，炒了一盘青菜再煎两个鸡蛋。饭菜做好，端到餐桌上，一边吃饭一边看会儿短视频，吃完之后洗碗收拾厨房。

## My translation

I cooked a simple dinner at home in the evening. I walked into the kitchen and took out vegetables and eggs from the fridge. I washed the vegetables and cut up the ingredients. I turned on the stove, poured in some oil, stir-fried a plate of greens and fried two eggs. When the meal was ready, I carried the food to the dining table. I ate while watching short videos. After dinner, I washed the dishes and tidied up the kitchen.

## Revised version

I made myself a simple dinner one evening. I headed to the kitchen and pulled vegetables and eggs out of the fridge. After washing and chopping the ingredients, I turned on the stove, added some oil, stir-fried green vegetables and pan-fried two eggs. Once dinner was ready, I brought everything over to the table. I enjoyed my meal while scrolling through short videos. When I finished eating, I washed the dishes and cleaned up the kitchen.
